data.summary: Count the members a JSON filter matches (true matches everyone, false no one)

operands.name: filter
operands.help: The filter: an object of field conditions, or true/false

options.name: scope
options.help: Restrict the count to members matching this JSON value; {"$ref": "<member>"} names one member

domain.description: A member reference may be given as {"$ref": "<member>"}.

options.name: weight
options.help: Weigh each match by this factor; any number up to 1e20 in magnitude
